papers.title: GATE XE 2026 Trend-Based Mock Paper 1
papers.description: Section A (Engg Math) + Section B (Fluid Mechanics) + Section C (Materials). Comprehensive coverage across engineering fundamentals.
papers.predictionRationale: Section A (Engineering Mathematics) covers Linear Algebra, Calculus ODEs, and Vector Calculus — the core mathematical foundation. Section B (Fluid Mechanics) tests fluid statics, Bernoulli applications, and boundary layer theory. Section C (Materials Science) covers crystal structures, phase diagrams, and mechanical properties. Ideal for students choosing B+C combination.
